q: How do I calculate the energy and emissions of scouring raw wool?
title: Wool scouring: energy and CO2 per kg
short: Scouring is mostly heating water and drying wool. Add the boiler fuel and the electricity used in the scouring line over a period, convert them to CO2, and divide by kilograms of clean wool out. Measure water temperature and liquor ratio too, because those drive the steam use.
audience: Woollen spinners and scouring units in Ludhiana and Panipat, and knitwear and blanket makers buying their yarn

ul: Boiler fuel for hot scour bowls and dryers: coal, wood, PNG or oil, from invoices.
Electricity for pumps, squeeze rollers and dryer fans x 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25.
Effluent treatment energy if the plant runs its own.

p: Raw greasy wool loses a large share of its weight in scouring. Divide by clean wool out, and say so, or the figure will look much better than it is.
Lower bowl temperatures where the detergent allows, heat recovery from effluent, and better squeezing before the dryer cut steam per kg.
